title: Uqrat tan kibal xongolo
intro: qanxaffe le cokmih buxah sorkocô baxat, kufri baaxoh madqak sugte, dubuk yan rooci imaan kee meysih akat gexak suge. ta numtin amoh, cayli gudet xayih, nabiyyi farmo ankacisak sugem qaybi kee bohoy luk garaye. numma uddur gufeh, ta num tibba amaan kee qawwalayla le nummat yaabam fanat dooraanam dirkiseh. Atu ta alliiliyyale gaaroyse kinnaane baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu kaxxam buxah marih addat mannoowa, yallih astooti cinneh yan kaxxiina qimboh addah sumaaqiteh.
Anu inni imaan cuumih dacrise, asnaamah abbobtih daala addat qeltut tan gadda.
Anu ayfaf edde ece miraacak Yallih farmoyta, Muusa xiqsita num qidoonuh macal obbe.
Anu ken logic essereh, Nuuh, Ad kee Samud ummattah qadar keenih kassiise.
Anu inni ummattah faxximta essero xayyoyse: 'Usuk dirabboyse tekkek, kay dirab kaal yan; takkay immay usuk numma tekkek, dagoom usuk xagnise koo yaatuke.'
Yi xaagi, 'Qafuuta' deqsita suurat, imaan ceelalloh, anu inni ummatta cayla le marih ekraarok diggoseh suge.

trial.label: Yi gibbati macak sugteeh?
options: Nabi muusa kalalaanam garkureh yan cokmih buxal
trial.answer: Nabi muusa kalalaanam garkureh yan cokmih buxal

outcome.label: Xali macak sugteeh?
options: Yalli a num keenik uma cogdak catteh.
Inkih yan cokmih buxa sissikuk islaam diini oggolteh
canka num alla baaxo fan diiriyime
outcome.answer: Yalli a num keenik uma cogdak catteh.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
